significance: A 12th-century Katyuri temple complex on the bank of the Gomati in Bageshwar district, now a Monument of National Importance and a stop on the Shiva Heritage Circuit. Besides Shiva it houses images of Parvati, Ganesha, Chandika, Kubera, Surya and Brahma.
story: Shiva and Parvati are said to have been married at the confluence of the Gomati and the Garur Ganga here.
